# mathcheck

> Checks maths worksheets, tests and answer keys (IGCSE, IB AA/AI, AP Calculus/Precalculus/Statistics, Cambridge A-Level 9709) for wrong answers, rounding errors, out-of-syllabus questions and mark totals, using sympy.

If a teacher asks you to check a worksheet with this repository, follow AGENTS.md step by step.

## Instructions
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yeah-genie/tutoring_automatization/main/AGENTS.md): full procedure for AI assistants

## Engine
- [mathcheck_lite.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yeah-genie/tutoring_automatization/main/integrations/engine/mathcheck_lite.py): single-file checker (sympy only)
- [curricula/](https://github.com/yeah-genie/tutoring_automatization/tree/main/integrations/engine/curricula): syllabus JSON per course

## Optional
- [Quiz spec guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yeah-genie/tutoring_automatization/main/docs/quiz_spec_guide.md)
- [Demo worksheet with 4 planted mistakes](https://github.com/yeah-genie/tutoring_automatization/blob/main/examples/demo_worksheet.pdf)
